extraction.name: SQuAD: 100,000+ Questions for Machine Comprehension of Text
extraction.description: A reading comprehension dataset consisting of 100,000+ questions posed by crowdworkers on a set of Wikipedia articles
extraction.creator: Pranav Rajpurkar, Jian Zhang, Konstantin Lopyrev, Percy Liang
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was collected in three stages: curating passages, crowdsourcing question-answers on those passages, and obtaining additional answers. Crowdworkers were employed to create questions and answers on the content of paragraphs from Wikipedia articles.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Surveys, Web Scraping, User-generated content data
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data collection is based on Wikipedia articles. The top 10000 articles of English Wikipedia were retrieved and 536 articles were sampled uniformly at random.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Passage curation: individual paragraphs were extracted from articles, stripping away images, figures, tables, and discarding paragraphs shorter than 500 characters. The articles were partitioned randomly into a training set (80%), a development set (10%), and a test set (10%).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Crowdworkers were tasked with asking and answering up to 5 questions on the content of each paragraph. The questions had to be entered in a text field, and the answers had to be highlighted in the paragraph.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Daemo platform with Amazon Mechanical Turk as its backend
